  • Military actions: IDF reports strikes on Hezbollah operatives in Lebanon. Northern border active daily with cross-border fire and small-scale exchanges. US/Israeli air operations against Iranian targets continue campaign-wide (ongoing, limited details).
  • Security incidents: Russian TASS says perpetrators of the bus attack on children identified and wanted (investigative committee statement) — could prompt fast police/ intelligence moves.
  • Domestic — Israel: Police clashed with ultra-Orthodox anti-draft protesters. Northern emergency response teams report reduced mobilization and warn of capacity stress.
  • Intelligence & politics: Russian security official met Iranian reps in New Delhi. Pentagon asks Congress for roughly $80 billion to cover Iran war costs.
  • Other: M4.2 earthquake 35 km SE of Mehrān, Iran (depth 10 km) — minor, no large damage reports in open sources.
  • 🟢 Good News: Oman–Iran talks on navigation moving forward; second pause announced gives a diplomatic window (10 days) for de-escalation if honored.

Threat assessment: Escalating
